instruction: A candid full-shot photograph taken from a low angle shows a partner acrobatics pose outdoors against a clear blue sky. On top of a light-brown stone block, the man in the black t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands in a wide, stable squat. He holds his arms up to support the woman in the black crop top and denim shorts (R1), who crouches above him. The woman balances by holding both of his hands, looking forward with a neutral expression while the man maintains a focused gaze. The scene is illuminated by bright, direct sunlight, casting soft shadows on their clothing and the stone structure.
